clips.zh: 他一直很努力，所以成绩提高得很快。
clips.en: He has always worked hard, so his grades improve very quickly.
notes: 一直 yìzhí: 一 is said yì (falling) before the rising 直.
提高 tígāo: a rise, then a high flat tone.

clips.zh: 我对这个城市的交通不太满意。
clips.en: I am not very satisfied with the traffic in this city.
notes: 交通 jiāotōng: both syllables are high and flat.
不太 bú tài: 不 is said bú (rising) before a falling tone.

clips.zh: 老师批评了他，但是也表扬了他的努力。
clips.en: The teacher criticised him, but also praised his effort.
notes: 批评 pīpíng: a high tone, then a rise.
表扬 biǎoyáng: 表 only dips before the rising 扬.

clips.zh: 这家餐厅的菜味道很特别，价格也不高。
clips.en: The flavour at this restaurant is special, and the prices are not high either.
notes: 味道 wèidào: both syllables fall.
特别 tèbié: a fall, then a rise.

clips.zh: 如果你有困难，可以给我打电话。
clips.en: If you have any difficulty, you can call me.
notes: 困难 kùnnan: the second syllable is light and short.
打电话 dǎ diànhuà: a dip, then fall, fall.

clips.zh: 他的汉语说得越来越流利了。
clips.en: His Chinese is getting more and more fluent.
notes: 越来越 yuè lái yuè: fall, rise, fall.
流利 liúlì: a rise, then a fall.

clips.zh: 为了保护环境，我们应该少用塑料。
clips.en: To protect the environment, we should use less plastic.
notes: 保护 bǎohù: 保 only dips before the falling 护.
塑料 sùliào: both syllables fall.

clips.zh: 经理让大家下午三点准时开会。
clips.en: The manager asked everyone to have the meeting at three o'clock sharp this afternoon.
notes: 准时 zhǔnshí: 准 only dips before the rising 时.
开会 kāihuì: a high tone, then a fall.

clips.zh: 昨天的演出非常精彩，观众们都笑了。
clips.en: Yesterday's performance was wonderful, and the audience all laughed.
notes: 精彩 jīngcǎi: a high tone, then a dip.
演出 yǎnchū: 演 only dips before the high 出.

clips.zh: 我的手机突然没电了，所以无法联系你。
clips.en: My phone suddenly ran out of battery, so I could not contact you.
notes: 突然 tūrán: a high tone, then a rise.
无法 wúfǎ: a rise, then a dip.

clips.zh: 这个城市的交通比以前方便多了。
clips.en: The traffic in this city is much more convenient than before.
notes: 方便 fāngbiàn: a high tone, then a fall.
以前 yǐqián: 以 only dips before the rising 前.

clips.zh: 他故意不说话，让大家有点担心。
clips.en: He deliberately does not speak, which makes everyone a bit worried.
notes: 故意 gùyì: both syllables fall.
担心 dānxīn: both syllables are high and flat.

clips.zh: 请把这些材料整理好，下午交给我。
clips.en: Please sort these materials out and hand them to me this afternoon.
notes: 整理 zhěnglǐ: two third tones in a row, so 整 rises (say zhénglǐ).
材料 cáiliào: a rise, then a fall.

clips.zh: 虽然他很累，但是仍然坚持工作。
clips.en: Although he is tired, he still keeps on working.
notes: 仍然 réngrán: both syllables rise.
坚持 jiānchí: a high tone, then a rise.

clips.zh: 我们要互相帮助，共同完成这个任务。
clips.en: We must help each other and complete this task together.
notes: 互相 hùxiāng: a fall, then a high tone.
共同 gòngtóng: a fall, then a rise.

clips.zh: 无论天气怎么样，我都要去跑步。
clips.en: No matter what the weather is like, I will go running.
notes: 无论 wúlùn: a rise, then a fall.
怎么样 zěnmeyàng: 么 is light and short.

clips.zh: 他不但会说汉语，而且会写汉字。
clips.en: He can not only speak Chinese but also write characters.
notes: 不但 búdàn: 不 is said bú before the falling 但.
而且 érqiě: a rise, then a dip.

clips.zh: 请问，附近有银行或者超市吗？
clips.en: Excuse me, is there a bank or a supermarket nearby?
notes: 附近 fùjìn: both syllables fall.
或者 huòzhě: a fall, then a dip.

clips.zh: 听说这部电影非常有名，我想去看看。
clips.en: I hear this film is very famous, and I want to go and see it.
notes: 听说 tīngshuō: both syllables are high and flat.
有名 yǒumíng: 有 only dips before the rising 名.

clips.zh: 周末我们打算去参观一家工厂。
clips.en: This weekend we plan to visit a factory.
notes: 参观 cānguān: both syllables are high and flat.
打算 dǎsuàn: a dip, then a fall.

clips.zh: 他被老师表扬了，心里特别高兴。
clips.en: He was praised by the teacher and is especially happy.
notes: 被 bèi: a short fall that marks who does the action.
心里 xīnlǐ: a high tone, then a dip.

clips.zh: 我从来没有见过这么大的雪。
clips.en: I have never seen such heavy snow.
notes: 从来 cónglái: both syllables rise.
见过 jiàn guo: after a verb, 过 is light (guo).

clips.zh: 这件事很重要，也很复杂。
clips.en: This matter is very important and also very complicated.
notes: 重要 zhòngyào: both syllables fall.
复杂 fùzá: a fall, then a rise.

clips.zh: 请把声音关小一点，大家都在休息。
clips.en: Please turn the sound down a little; everyone is resting.
notes: 声音 shēngyīn: both syllables are high and flat.
休息 xiūxi: 息 is light and short.
